# -*- coding: utf-8 -*- """ cars_ui.py — экраны карточки авто (версия 5) для внутреннего бота. Подключается одной строкой в team_bot.py: import cars_ui ... cars_ui.register(app) # в build_application(), перед return Модуль перехватывает открытие карточек авто и добавляет: · карточку по новой схеме (42 поля, блоками) · галерею фото до 99, порядок кадров ставит бот · два слота видео — горизонтальное и вертикальное · техсостояние: описание, до 100 фото, до 100 видео, отчёт диагностики и ссылка · логистику по 4 этапам и счётчик дней до Киева · цену по этапам с напоминанием при переходе · правку любого поля кнопкой или фразой в чат Старые экраны бота не трогаются: карточки клиентов, входящие, ИИ-разбор и согласование работают как работали. """ import json import logging from telegram import InlineKeyboardButton, InlineKeyboardMarkup, Update from telegram.ext import ( ApplicationHandlerStop, CallbackQueryHandler, ContextTypes, MessageHandler, filters, ) import cars_schema as S import card_render as CR import db from datetime import date as _date, datetime as _dt, timedelta as _td log = logging.getLogger(__name__) PHOTO_PAGE = 12 # сколько превью показываем за раз VIDEO_LIMIT = 100 # видео в карточке LEGACY = { # старое поле -> новое "engine": "engine_cc", "mileage": "mileage_km", "condition": "condition_text", "stage": "status", "price_total": "cost_total", } # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── # СЛУЖЕБНОЕ # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── def ensure_columns(): """Добавляет колонки, которых нет ни в старой схеме, ни в cars_schema.""" extra = [("price_history", "TEXT"), ("cover_photo", "TEXT"), ("eta_manual", "TEXT")] with db.connect() as c: have = {r["name"] for r in c.execute("PRAGMA table_info(cars)").fetchall()} for name, decl in extra: if name not in have: try: c.execute("ALTER TABLE cars ADD COLUMN %s %s" % (name, decl)) log.info("Добавлена колонка cars.%s", name) except Exception as e: log.warning("Не добавил cars.%s: %s", name, e) def jload(value, default=None): if not value: return default if default is not None else [] try: out = json.loads(value) return out if isinstance(out, (list, dict)) else (default or []) except Exception: return default if default is not None else [] def jdump(value): return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False) def card_of(card_id): card = db.get_card("cars", int(card_id)) if not card: return None # старые значения подтягиваем в новые поля, если новые пустые for old, new in LEGACY.items(): if not card.get(new) and card.get(old): card[new] = card[old] return card def photos_of(card): """Список фото. Заглавная — передняя часть, за ней VIN и одометр.""" raw = jload(card.get("photos")) items = [] for p in raw: if isinstance(p, dict): items.append(p) else: items.append({"file_id": p, "tag": ""}) cover = card.get("cover_photo") if cover: items.sort(key=lambda p: 0 if p.get("file_id") == cover else 1) return items return S.order_photos(items) def videos_of(card): """Все видео карточки списком, до 30 штук.""" out = [] for v in jload(card.get("videos")): out.append(v if isinstance(v, dict) else {"file_id": v, "tag": ""}) for old, tag in ((card.get("video_h"), "гориз"), (card.get("video_v"), "вертик")): if old and not any(p.get("file_id") == old for p in out): out.append({"file_id": old, "tag": tag}) return out def price_history(card): return jload(card.get("price_history"), {}) or {} def price_stale(card): """Цену на текущем этапе ещё не подтверждали — надо напомнить.""" etap = S.stage_of(card.get("status")) if not etap: return False return str(etap) not in price_history(card) def set_field(card_id, field, value, actor_id): """Пустое значение в карточку не пишем — данные не теряются.""" if value in (None, "", []): return db.update_card_field("cars", int(card_id), field, value, actor_id) def drop_wait(context): """Открыли другой экран — прежний запрос значения отменяется.""" try: context.user_data.pop("car_wait", None) context.user_data.pop("car_media_wait", None) except Exception: pass def is_owner(staff): return bool(staff) and staff.get("role") == db.ROLE_OWNER # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── # ТЕКСТ КАРТОЧКИ # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── def render(card, staff): L = [] L.append("%s" % (card.get("auto_number") or "#%s" % card.get("id"))) miss = S.missing_required(card) if miss: L.append("Черновик · не хватает %d полей" % len(miss)) else: L.append("%s · %s" % ( db.STATUS_LABELS.get(card.get("review_status"), ""), "в каталоге" if card.get("published") else "не опубликовано")) photos = photos_of(card) vids = videos_of(card) L.append("Фото: %d из %d · видео: %d из %d" % ( len(photos), S.PHOTO_LIMIT, len(vids), VIDEO_LIMIT)) L.append("") L.append("ИДЕНТИФИКАЦИЯ") L.append("Марка: %s" % (card.get("brand") or "—")) L.append("Модель: %s" % (card.get("model") or "—")) L.append("Год выпуска: %s" % (card.get("year") or "—")) L.append("VIN: %s" % (card.get("vin") or "—")) if card.get("vin"): ok, msg = S.check_vin(card.get("vin"), _year(card)) L.append(" %s" % msg) L.append("") L.append("ТЕХНИКА") L.append("Топливо: %s" % (card.get("fuel") or "—")) L.append("Объём: %s" % S.num(_int(card.get("engine_cc")), " см³")) L.append("КПП: %s" % (card.get("gearbox") or "—")) L.append("Привод: %s" % (card.get("drive") or "—")) L.append("Пробег: %s" % S.num(_int(card.get("mileage_km")), " км")) L.append("Цвет: %s" % (card.get("color") or "—")) L.append("") L.append("ТЕХНИЧЕСКОЕ СОСТОЯНИЕ") L.append(card.get("condition_text") or "—") L.append("Фото: %d из %d · видео: %d из %d" % ( len(jload(card.get("condition_photos"))), S.CONDITION_PHOTO_LIMIT, len(jload(card.get("condition_videos"))), S.CONDITION_VIDEO_LIMIT)) if card.get("diag_report") or card.get("diag_link"): L.append("Диагностика: отчёт загружен") if card.get("diag_link"): L.append(' полный отчёт' % card["diag_link"]) L.append("") stage = S.stage_of(card.get("status")) L.append("ЛОГИСТИКА · ЭТАП %d ИЗ 4" % (stage or 1)) for n, name in S.STAGES: mark = "пройден" if n < stage else ("сейчас" if n == stage else "—") L.append("%d. %s: %s" % (n, name, mark)) if card.get("status"): L.append("Статус: %s" % S.status_label(card.get("status"))) if card.get("sea_container"): L.append("Контейнер: %s" % card["sea_container"]) left, eta = eta_of(card) # Подпись зависит от того, где машина сейчас. # На море счёт идёт до Грузии, до Киева — только когда она уже в Грузии. podpis = {2: "ДО ПОТИ/БАТУМИ", 3: "ДО КИЕВА"}.get(stage) if left is not None and podpis: L.append("") L.append("🚚 %s: %d дней" % (podpis, left)) L.append("ориентировочно %s%s" % ( eta.strftime("%d.%m.%Y"), " · задано вручную" if card.get("eta_manual") else "")) klient = client_of(card) if klient: L.append("") L.append("ПОКУПАТЕЛЬ") L.append("Имя: %s" % (klient.get("name") or "—")) L.append("Телефон: %s" % (klient.get("phone") or "—")) if klient.get("telegram"): L.append("Telegram: %s" % klient["telegram"]) if klient.get("prepayment"): L.append("Предоплата: %s" % klient["prepayment"]) if klient.get("wishes"): L.append("Заметка: %s" % klient["wishes"]) if # -*- coding: utf-8 -*- # UA-STROY-V6 — СБОРЩИК КАТАЛОГА И ГЛАВНОЙ ИЗ НЕИЗМЕНЯЕМОГО УТВЕРЖДЁННОГО ШАБЛОНА. # Структура берётся ТОЛЬКО из /home/Carix/shablon_utv (фиксируется при первом запуске # из etalon_dizayna или video/preview/v4). Текущие боевые index/katalog донором НЕ служат. # Пишет только /video/proba2-katalog.html, /video/proba2-index.html и отчёт. # Production, база, код, CSS, фото и видео НЕ ТРОГАЮТСЯ. import os import re import sys import time import shutil import hashlib KOREN = os.environ.get("STROY_KOREN", "/home/Carix") SAJT = os.environ.get("STROY_SAJT", "https://www.uaart.com.ua") P_VIDEO = os.path.join(KOREN, "video") SHABLON = os.path.join(KOREN, "shablon_utv") sys.path.insert(0, KOREN) import stroy3 as S STROKI = S.STROKI OSHIBKI = S.OSHIBKI p, zag, sboy, chitat = S.p, S.zag, S.sboy, S.chitat # источники утверждённого вида, по порядку доверия ISTOCHNIKI = [SHABLON, os.path.join(KOREN, "etalon_dizayna"), os.path.join(P_VIDEO, "preview", "v4")] OBYAZ = ["{KOD}", "{NAZVANIE}", "{CENA}", "{ETAPKOD}"] ZHELATELNO = ["{GLAVFOTO}", "{MEDIA}"] def sha(t): return hashlib.sha256(t.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() def godnyy(imya, t): """Признаки утверждённого вида. Возвращает (годен, пояснение).""" if not t: return False, "файла нет или он пуст" if imya == "index.html": if "stage-card" not in t: return False, "нет stage-card" if "stage-live" not in t: return False, "нет stage-live" return True, "stage-card и stage-live на месте" if "" if not re.search(r"data-stage\s*=", t): return False, "нет data-stage у карточек" return True, "article и data-stage на месте" def najti_shablon(): zag("1. """UA-ART-SITE-GE-002: bounded file transaction; no services, CRM or database writes.

PAYLOAD contains javascript, injector_source, patch_generator_source,
generator_sha256, legacy_js_sha256, legacy_js_replacements, html_paths and
optional_etalon_paths.  All paths are relative to the explicitly supplied root.
The two renderer modules are only compiled as strings, never imported/executed.
"""
import argparse
import datetime
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import stat
import sys
import tempfile
import types

TASK = 'UA-ART-SITE-GE-002'
LOCKS = ('.ua_art_publish_transaction.lock', '.ua_art_production_writer.lock')
ALLOWED_GENERATORS = ('stranica.py', 'yadro.py', 'publikaciya.py', 'publish_transaction_guard.py')
REQUIRED_HTML = tuple(['video/index.html', 'video/katalog.html', 'video/podbor.html', 'video/info.html'] +
                      [f'video/UA-{i:04d}.html' for i in range(1, 19)] +
                      [f'video/UA-{i:04d}-diag.html' for i in range(1, 19)])


class ReleaseFailure(RuntimeError):
    def __init__(self, receipt):
        self.receipt = receipt
        super().__init__(receipt.get('error', receipt.get('status', 'RELEASE_FAILED')))


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def relative(value):
    require(isinstance(value, str) and value != '', 'INVALID_RELATIVE_PATH')
    p = Path(value)
    require(not p.is_absolute() and all(x not in ('', '.', '..') for x in value.split('/')),
            'INVALID_RELATIVE_PATH: ' + value)
    require(str(p) == value and '\\' not in value, 'NONCANONICAL_PATH: ' + value)
    return p


def no_symlinks(path):
    """Inspect every existing component; never resolve away a symlink."""
    path = Path(path).absolute()
    for item in reversed((path,) + tuple(path.parents)):
        try:
            info = item.lstat()
        except FileNotFoundError:
            continue
        require(not stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode), 'SYMLINK_PATH: ' + str(item))
        if item != path:
            require(stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode), 'NON_DIRECTORY_COMPONENT: ' + str(item))
    return path


def target(root, name):
    return no_symlinks(root / relative(name))


def snapshot(path, required=True):
    no_symlinks(path)
    try:
        fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, 'O_NOFOLLOW', 0))
    except FileNotFoundError:
        require(not required, 'REQUIRED_FILE_MISSING: ' + str(path))
        return {'exists': False, 'data': None, 'sha256': None, 'mode': 0o644}
    with os.fdopen(fd, 'rb') as handle:
        info = os.fstat(handle.fileno())
        require(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode), 'NONREGULAR_TARGET: ' + str(path))
        data = handle.read()
    return {'exists': True, 'data': data, 'sha256': sha(data), 'mode': stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode)}


def same(path, state):
    now = snapshot(path, required=False)
    return now['exists'] == state['exists'] and now['sha256'] == state['sha256']


def fsync_directory(path):
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, 'O_DIRECTORY', 0))
    try:
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def atomic_write(path, data, mode):
    no_symlinks(path)
    require(path.parent.is_dir(), 'MISSING_TARGET_PARENT: ' + str(path.parent))
    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.site-ge-', dir=str(path.parent))
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'wb') as handle:
            handle.write(data)
            handle.flush()
            os.fchmod(handle.fileno(), mode)
            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
        no_symlinks(path)
        os.replace(temporary, path)
        fsync_directory(path.parent)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temporary):
            os.unlink(temporary)


def module_from_source(name, source):
    """Execute only our reviewed pure patch helper, never target renderer source."""
    require(isinstance(source, str), 'INVALID_HELPER_SOURCE')
    module = types.ModuleType(name)
    previous = sys.modules.get(name)
    sys.modules[name] = module  # dataclass type resolution requires registration.
    try:
        exec(compile(source, name + '.py', 'exec'), module.__dict__)
    finally:
        if previous is None:
            sys.modules.pop(name, None)
        else:
            sys.modules[name] = previous
    return module


def scope(payload):
    html = payload.get('html_paths', list(REQUIRED_HTML))
    require(len(html) == 40 and set(html) == set(REQUIRED_HTML), 'REQUIRED_40_HTML_SCOPE_MISMATCH')
    extra = payload.get('optional_etalon_paths', [])
    require(isinstance(extra, list) and len(extra) <= 40, 'INVALID_OPTIONAL_ETALON_LIST')
    for name in extra:
        p = relative(name)
        require(p.suffix.lower() == '.html' and name not in REQUIRED_HTML and
                p.parts[0] not in ('backups', 'video') and not any(x.startswith('.') for x in p.parts),
                'INVALID_OPTIONAL_ETALON_PATH: ' + name)
    require(len(set(extra)) == len(extra), 'DUPLICATE_OPTIONAL_ETALON_PATH')
    return list(REQUIRED_HTML), extra


def generator_names(payload):
    names = set(payload['generator_sha256'])
    require(set(('stranica.py', 'yadro.py')) <= names <= set(ALLOWED_GENERATORS), 'GENERATOR_SCOPE_MISMATCH')
    return [name for name in ALLOWED_GENERATORS if name in names]


def legacy_candidate(before, payload):
    changes = payload['legacy_js_replacements']
    require(isinstance(changes, list) and 1 <= len(changes) <= 8, 'INVALID_LEGACY_PATCH_LIST')
    # Strict reviewed original digest. Already installed exact patches are accepted.
    source = before.decode('utf-8')
    if sha(before) != payload['legacy_js_sha256']:
        original = source
        for item in reversed(changes):
            require(item['old'] != item['new'] and original.count(item['new']) == item.get('count', 1),
                    'SHARED_LANGUAGE_SCRIPT_CHANGED')
            original = original.replace(item['new'], item['old'])
        require(sha(original.encode('utf-8')) == payload['legacy_js_sha256'], 'SHARED_LANGUAGE_SCRIPT_CHANGED')
    else:
        original = source
    candidate = original
    for item in changes:
        require(item['old'] != item['new'] and candidate.count(item['old']) == item.get('count', 1),
                'LEGACY_PATCH_ANCHOR_MISMATCH')
        candidate = candidate.replace(item['old'], item['new'])
    require(source == original or source == candidate, 'PARTIAL_LEGACY_PATCH')
    return candidate.encode('utf-8')


def prepare(root, payload):
    html, extra = scope(payload)
    injector = module_from_source('_ua_site_ge_inject_release', payload['injector_source'])
    patcher = module_from_source('_ua_site_ge_patch_release', payload['patch_generator_source'])
    compile(payload['injector_source'], 'site_ge_inject.py', 'exec')
    require(isinstance(payload['javascript'], str) and '__DICTIONARIES__' not in payload['javascript'],
            'UNBUILT_LANGUAGE_JAVASCRIPT')
    changes, states = [], {}

    def add(name, after, kind, required=True, collision=False, expected=None):
        path = target(root, name)
        old = snapshot(path, required=required)
        if expected is not None:
            require(old['exists'] == expected['exists'] and old['sha256'] == expected['sha256'],
                    'CONCURRENT_CHANGE_DURING_PREPARE: ' + name)
        states[name] = old
        if collision:
            require(not old['exists'] or old['data'] == after, 'NEW_RESOURCE_COLLISION: ' + name)
        if old['data'] != after:
            changes.append({'path': name, 'kind': kind, 'before': old, 'after': after,
                            'after_sha256': sha(after), 'after_mode': old['mode']})

    # Resource-before-consumer order is intentional and is reversed on rollback.
    add('video/ua-site-languages.js', payload['javascript'].encode('utf-8'), 'resource', False, True)
    add('site_ge_inject.py', payload['injector_source'].encode('utf-8'), 'resource', False, True)
    old = snapshot(target(root, 'video/i18n.js'))
    add('video/i18n.js', legacy_candidate(old['data'], payload), 'legacy_language', expected=old)
    for name in generator_names(payload):
        old = snapshot(target(root, name))
        source = old['data'].decode('utf-8')
        original = patcher.reverse_generator(name, source)
        require(sha(original.encode('utf-8')) == payload['generator_sha256'][name],
                'GENERATOR_SOURCE_CHANGED: ' + name)
        candidate = patcher.patch_generator(name, source)
        require(patcher.reverse_generator(name, candidate) == original, 'GENERATOR_REVERSE_FAILED: ' + name)
        compile(candidate, name, 'exec')
        add(name, candidate.encode('utf-8'), 'generator', expected=old)
    for name in html + extra:
        old = snapshot(target(root, name))
        source = old['data'].decode('utf-8')
        require(re.search(r'<html\b', source, re.I) and re.search(r'</html\s*>\s*$', source, re.I),
                'INCOMPLETE_HTML: ' + name)
        candidate = injector.inject_html(source)
        require(candidate.count('id="ua-art-site-languages"') == 1, 'HTML_MARKER_COUNT: ' + name)
        require(injector.inject_html(candidate) == candidate, 'HTML_INJECTION_NOT_IDEMPOTENT: ' + name)
        require(injector.normalize_patch(candidate) == injector.normalize_patch(source),
                'UNRELATED_HTML_CHANGE: ' + name)
        if 'id="ua-art-site-languages"' not in source:
            require(injector.normalize_patch(candidate) == source, 'HTML_REVERSE_NOT_EXACT: ' + name)
        add(name, candidate.encode('utf-8'), 'html' if name in html else 'etalon_html', expected=old)
    return changes, states


def public_entry(change):
    old = change['before']
    return {'path': change['path'], 'kind': change['kind'], 'existed_before': old['exists'],
            'before_sha256': old['sha256'], 'after_sha256': change['after_sha256'],
            'before_mode': old['mode'], 'after_mode': change['after_mode']}


def save_receipt(backup, receipt):
    atomic_write(no_symlinks(backup / 'receipt.json'),
                 (json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n').encode('utf-8'), 0o600)


def guard_all(root, states, applied):
    for name, old in states.items():
        expected = applied.get(name, old)
        require(same(target(root, name), expected), 'CONCURRENT_CHANGE: ' + name)


def rollback_owned(root, backup, receipt, payload):
    html, extra = scope(payload)
    allowed = set(html + extra + ['video/ua-site-languages.js', 'site_ge_inject.py', 'video/i18n.js'] + generator_names(payload))
    require(receipt.get('task_id') == TASK, 'ROLLBACK_TASK_MISMATCH')
    entries = receipt['files']
    require(len({x['path'] for x in entries}) == len(entries), 'ROLLBACK_DUPLICATE_PATH')
    require(all(x['path'] in allowed for x in entries), 'ROLLBACK_SCOPE_MISMATCH')
    owned = set(receipt.get('written_paths', []))
    active = receipt.get('active_path')
    if active:
        owned.add(active)
    restore = []
    # All ownership/backup checks precede the first rollback write.
    for entry in entries:
        if entry['path'] not in owned:
            continue
        path = target(root, entry['path'])
        now = snapshot(path, required=False)
        is_before = now['exists'] == entry['existed_before'] and now['sha256'] == entry['before_sha256']
        if is_before:
            continue  # active_path can precede a failed atomic write.
        require(now['exists'] and now['sha256'] == entry['after_sha256'],
                'ROLLBACK_CONCURRENT_CHANGE: ' + entry['path'])
        oldbytes = None
        if entry['existed_before']:
            oldbytes = snapshot(target(backup / 'files', entry['path']))['data']
            require(sha(oldbytes) == entry['before_sha256'], 'ROLLBACK_BACKUP_HASH_MISMATCH: ' + entry['path'])
        restore.append((entry, oldbytes))
    for entry, oldbytes in reversed(restore):
        path = target(root, entry['path'])
        require(snapshot(path)['sha256'] == entry['after_sha256'], 'ROLLBACK_CONCURRENT_CHANGE: ' + entry['path'])
        if entry['existed_before']:
            atomic_write(path, oldbytes, entry['before_mode'])
        else:
            path.unlink()
            fsync_directory(path.parent)
    receipt.update(status='ROLLED_BACK', active_path=None, rolled_back_at=utcnow(),
                   restored_paths=[entry['path'] for entry, _ in restore])
    save_receipt(backup, receipt)
    return receipt


def utcnow():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()


def run(root, mode, payload, backup_arg=None):
    require(mode in ('probe', 'apply', 'rollback'), 'INVALID_MODE')
    root = no_symlinks(Path(root).absolute())
    require(root.is_dir() and target(root, 'video').is_dir(), 'SITE_ROOT_MISSING')
    locks = []
    try:
        for name in LOCKS:
            path = target(root, name)
            fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | getattr(os, 'O_NOFOLLOW', 0), 0o600)
            handle = os.fdopen(fd, 'a+')
            locks.append(handle)
            require(stat.S_ISREG(os.fstat(handle.fileno()).st_mode), 'NONREGULAR_LOCK')
            fcntl.flock(handle.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        if mode == 'rollback':
            require(backup_arg is not None, 'BACKUP_REQUIRED')
            backup = no_symlinks(Path(backup_arg).absolute())
            require(backup.parent == root / 'backups' and backup.name.startswith('site_ge_002_') and backup.is_dir(),
                    'INVALID_BACKUP_DIRECTORY')
            receipt = json.loads(snapshot(backup / 'receipt.json')['data'])
            return rollback_owned(root, backup, receipt, payload)
        changes, states = prepare(root, payload)
        receipt = {'task_id': TASK, 'status': 'PROBE_PASS', 'prepared_at': utcnow(),
                   'production_touched': False, 'required_html_validated': 40,
                   'optional_etalon_count': len(payload.get('optional_etalon_paths', [])),
                   'files': [public_entry(x) for x in changes], 'written_paths': [], 'active_path': None,
                   'generator_imported_or_executed': False, 'service_or_crm_database_changes': False}
        guard_all(root, states, {})
        if mode == 'probe':
            return receipt
        if not changes:
            receipt['status'] = 'ALREADY_INSTALLED'
            return receipt
        backup_bytes = sum(len(c['before']['data'] or b'') for c in changes)
        require(shutil.disk_usage(root).free > backup_bytes * 3 + 2_000_000, 'INSUFFICIENT_BACKUP_SPACE')
        backup_parent = target(root, 'backups')
        backup_parent.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=True)
        backup = backup_parent / ('site_ge_002_' + datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ'))
        backup.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        receipt.update(backup=str(backup), status='PREPARING_BACKUP')
        save_receipt(backup, receipt)
        for change in changes:
            if change['before']['exists']:
                path = target(backup / 'files', change['path'])
                path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
                atomic_write(path, change['before']['data'], 0o600)
                require(snapshot(path)['sha256'] == change['before']['sha256'], 'BACKUP_VERIFY_FAILED')
        receipt['status'] = 'PREPARED'
        save_receipt(backup, receipt)
        applied = {}
        try:
            guard_all(root, states, applied)
            for change in changes:
                guard_all(root, states, applied)
                receipt.update(status='INSTALLING', active_path=change['path'])
                save_receipt(backup, receipt)
                path = target(root, change['path'])
                receipt['production_touched'] = True
                atomic_write(path, change['after'], change['after_mode'])
                applied[change['path']] = {'exists': True, 'sha256': change['after_sha256']}
                receipt['written_paths'].append(change['path'])
                receipt.update(production_touched=True, active_path=None)
                save_receipt(backup, receipt)
                guard_all(root, states, applied)
            receipt.update(status='INSTALLED_AWAITING_LIVE_VERIFY', completed_at=utcnow())
            save_receipt(backup, receipt)
            return receipt
        except BaseException as error:
            receipt['error'] = type(error).__name__ + ': ' + str(error)
            try:
                rollback_owned(root, backup, receipt, payload)
                receipt['status'] = 'FAILED_AUTOMATICALLY_ROLLED_BACK'
            except BaseException as rollback_error:
                receipt.update(status='CONCURRENT_CHANGE_REQUIRES_REVIEW', rollback_error=str(rollback_error))
            save_receipt(backup, receipt)
            raise ReleaseFailure(receipt) from error
    finally:
        for handle in reversed(locks):
            handle.close()


PAYLOAD = json.loads('{"javascript": "/* UA-ART-SITE-GE-002: language presentation only.
